theme_and_archetype.domain: Corporate Summit / Real Estate Investment Website
theme_and_archetype.rationale: Arsa Yatırım Zirvesi 2026 targets high-net-worth individuals, real estate investors, and corporate professionals. A deep navy blue and gold palette conveys prestige, trust, and exclusivity, aligning with the luxurious feel of a premium corporate event at Hilton Istanbul Bosphorus.

rules: Headings (Playfair Display) must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).
Labels and overlines must be uppercase, tiny, and widely spaced.
Never center paragraphs. Left-align dense content.
The 'Inter' font is banned. Use 'Outfit' for all body text.

bento_grid.mode: MODE A: THE 'TETRIS' GRID (For Speakers and Agenda)

cards.default: bg-[#14213D] border border-white/10 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-lg

borders.tracing_beam: use framer-motion to create a glowing border effect around the main registration card or featured speaker.

marketing_pages.structure: Custom HTML/Tailwind. Avoid standard Shadcn layout containers for the main site.
marketing_pages.hero: Cinematic full-width background image with maximum bg-[#0A1128]/60 overlay. Playfair Display heading, gold CTA.
marketing_pages.speakers: Bento grid layout. Muhammet Özdemir (Zirve Sahibi) must take the dominant 'Hero' span (col-span-8). Other speakers take standard spans.
marketing_pages.marquee: Use an 'Editorial Ribbon' for sponsors or past event highlights. Slow, smooth drift. Pale gold background with deep navy text.

admin_dashboard.structure: Shadcn UI heavily customized. Dark mode by default to match the brand.
admin_dashboard.tables: Shadcn Data Tables for Members, Guests, Speakers.
admin_dashboard.forms: Shadcn Forms with React Hook Form for Registration, Settings.

icons_and_assets.usage: Use Duotone weight for marketing pages, Regular weight for admin dashboard.

images.description: Luxurious navy and gold architectural background.
Hilton Istanbul Bosphorus style luxury conference hall.
Modern urban real estate skyline for thematic backgrounds.

media.rules: All images MUST use the provided URLs. DO NOT use placeholders. Keep hero overlays between 30% and 60% opacity to ensure text readability without hiding the image.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links) MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='register-button').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text contrast over images using text-shadow or gradient overlays. Gold text must have sufficient contrast against navy background.

specific_instructions_for_main_agent.1: Use React + Tailwind CSS. Set the global background color to #0A1128 and text color to white.
specific_instructions_for_main_agent.2: For the marketing frontend, build custom layouts without Shadcn containers to allow overlapping elements and creative grids.
specific_instructions_for_main_agent.3: For the Admin Panel, utilize Shadcn UI components extensively to ensure rapid, accessible development of tables, dialogs, and forms.
specific_instructions_for_main_agent.4: Make sure Muhammet Özdemir is highlighted prominently on the homepage, significantly larger than other speakers (e.g., span 8 out of 12 columns in a grid).
specific_instructions_for_main_agent.5: Registration must be clearly marked as 'Ücretsiz' (Free).
